thread:
sara_fin: Heads up — incoming wire for $152,430 from Acme Corp posted to our account this morning but NO remittance/reference. Invoice RD-2026-0891 still showing unpaid. Can anyone help match?

leo_support: @sara_fin can you paste the bank advice or MT103 snippet (sanitized) so we can see any sender refs? :eyes:

sara_fin: MT103 excerpt: "Ordering Customer: ACME HOLDINGS LTD; Beneficiary: REDWOOD INFERENCE LTD; IBAN: GB12REDD00012345678; Remittance Information: NOT PROVIDED" — bank attached a PDF receipt but no invoice/PO number.

alex_g: If remittance info is empty, often banks put the customer ref into the SWIFT UETR or into the originator-to-beneficiary field. Ask the bank to provide full message fields or UETR trace.

nina_ops: I opened a trace request with our bank — ticket BANK-4521. Bank asked for value date and amount, I provided: 2026-03-14, USD 152,430. They said will escalate to payments ops.

billing-bot: Payment record created: amount=152430.00 USD; method=bank_transfer; status=posted_unallocated; reference=null; source=ACME HOLDINGS LTD.

leo_support: Two parallel actions: (1) I can email Acme AP asking for payment advice and any internal PO/our invoice ref. (2) nina, please push for the UETR or MT103 full fields.

sara_fin: Please send the email — use this short template when contacting their AP:

```
Hi Accounts Payable,

We received a wire for USD 152,430 on 2026-03-14 to our bank (Redwood Inference Ltd) but the remittance/reference was blank. Could you confirm which invoices or PO this payment covers?

Invoice: RD-2026-0891
Amount: USD 152,430
Value date: 2026-03-14
Bank advice/UTR (if available): <please attach>

If this payment was meant for multiple invoices, please list them or provide your internal payment reference so we can allocate.

Thanks,
Sara (Billing)
```

alex_g: Also ask them to include the originating account number and the exact transaction reference — sometimes subsidiaries pay using a different legal name and we need to know the originating account to match.

leo_support: I pinged Acme at ap@acme.example.com and CC'd their finance lead. Sent request at 09:37 GMT, included the bank PDF.

nina_ops: Bank replied to BANK-4521: "We can provide MT103 full fields and UETR trace in 24-48hrs once we receive formal request from beneficiary." I've uploaded the bank ticket number to our CRM.

sara_fin: FYI Acme responded: they say payment originated from Acme EU (Acct ****9876) and their PO 5678 was on their side, but they didn't include our invoice number. They're confirming whether PO 5678 maps to our invoice RD-2026-0891.

leo_support: If Acme confirms it maps, we'll allocate and mark invoice paid. If not, escalate to collections. For now I put the payment on a temporary suspense account and flagged for reconciliation.

billing-bot: Reconciliation update: transaction moved to suspense_gl_2201 pending allocation.

alex_g: Next steps checklist: 1) wait for bank MT103/UETR (nina) 2) confirm mapping with Acme AP (leo) 3) once matched, update invoice and move funds from suspense (sara) 4) if no match in 7 days, open collections case.

sara_fin: Thanks — I'm drafting the internal note for the CFO in case they ask for proof. Will update thread when allocation done. :thumbsup:
